primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: The number of facial inflammatory lesions (papules and pustules) on the face (excluding the neck and scalp area) was counted. Papule was a small, solid elevation 5 millimeters (mm) or less in diameter. Pastule was a small, circumscribed elevation of the skin that contains yellow-white exudate.

groups.description: Participants received a starting dose of 400 mg of imsidolimab on Day 1 followed by 200 mg imsidolimab every 4 weeks (Days 29, 57 and 85) by subcutaneous injection.
groups.title: Imsidolimab

groups.description: Participants received imsidolimab matching placebo on Day 1 and thereafter, every 4 weeks (Days 29, 57 and 85) by subcutaneous injection.
groups.title: Placebo

primaryOutcomeMeasures.populationDescription: Due to early study termination, no participant was evaluated in the imsidolimab group and 1 participant was evaluated in the placebo group. Since only 1 participant was evaluated, results were not reported for the protection of personal data and to avoid re-identification.
primaryOutcomeMeasures.title: Change From Baseline in Facial Inflammatory Lesion Count (Papules and Pustules) at Week 8
